body: Surely the expected behavior should be that the correct statusline is shown? :) The assertions are only triggered on a debug build. If you build neovim with `CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release` you'll see a similarly corrupted statusline, but neovim won't crash.

### Neovim version (nvim -v)

v0.8.1

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

no, vim 9.0

### Operating system/version

Fedora 36 (with kernel 6.0.15-200.fc36.x86_64）

### Terminal name/version

Alacritty 0.10.1 (I am running nvim inside tmux, if this matters)

### $TERM environment variable

tmux-256color

### Installation

system package manager

### How to reproduce the issue

1. Just execute 
   
    ```shell
    $ nvim ElasticSearch底层搜索引擎
    ```

2. Then you will get
    
    ```
    E325: ATTENTION
    Found a swap file by the name "~/.local/state/nvim/swap//%home%steve%Documents%Notes%database%lucene%articles%ElasticSearch底层搜索引擎.swp"
              owned by: steve   dated: Sun Jan 01 21:02:02 2023
             file name: ~steve/Documents/Notes/database/lucene/articles/ElasticSearch底层搜索引擎
              modified: no
             user name: steve   host name: fedora
            process ID: 68868
    While opening file "ElasticSearch底层搜索引擎"
          CANNOT BE FOUND
    (1) Another program may be editing the same file.  If this is the case,
        be careful not to end up with two different instances of the same
        file when making changes.  Quit, or continue with caution.
    (2) An edit session for this file crashed.
        If this is the case, use ":recover" or "vim -r ElasticSearch底层搜索引擎"

    p"

    Swap file "~/.local/state/nvim/swap//%home%steve%Documents%Notes%database%lucene%articles%ElasticSearch底层搜索引擎.swp" already exists!
    [O]pen Read-Only, (E)dit anyway, (R)ecover, (D)elete it, (Q)uit, (A)bort:
    ```

    I don't think it is the first case that there are mutliple processes editing this file

3. Input `D` to exit the above TUI interface, then it just crashes with the following error message:
    
     ```
    nvim: /builddir/build/BUILD/neovim-0.8.1/src/nvim/ui_compositor.c:582: ui_comp_raw_line: Assertion `attrs[i] >= 0' failed.
                           [1]    73660 IOT instruction (core dumped)  nvim ElasticSearch底层搜索引擎
     ```

   And it messed my terminal up:

   
   ![Screenshot from 2023-01-01 21-19-06](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/96880612/210171960-bd99e92d-09ed-4b63-84e2-68c616ba5423.png)


### Expected behavior

No error should occur

### Actual behavior

It crashed...

body: The crash is not specific to newline, it applies to any non-printable character.
If `` is changed to `▎`, it crashes with one newline as well.
